system.description:
Druids trained in the Tanatharen Woods by Sihnora, the sentient tree who guards them; outsiders can speak with him only through a druid of this circle.

  • Voice of the Grove: one extra use of Wild Shape per day, and Advantage on Language of the Wilderlands checks with trees and plants.
    • 9th level: once per day, cast Entangle without expending a slot.
  • Ancient Communion: Advantage on checks to commune with, identify or bargain with ancient or sentient plants.
